title: Random Hearts
description: A cop (Harrison Ford) and a politician (Kristin Scott Thomas) seek the truth about their spouses, killed together in a plane crash on the way to the same address.

title: All the King's Men
description: A Southern politician's (Sean Penn) idealism and good intentions give way to corruption after he becomes governor of Louisiana.

title: Bram Stoker's Dracula
description: The vampire count (Gary Oldman) of Transylvania seeks his lost love (Winona Ryder) and the conquest of Britain by plague.

title: Straw Dogs
description: A screenwriter (James Marsden) and his wife (Kate Bosworth) are pushed into a violent confrontation with locals after they move to the woman's Mississippi hometown for the summer.

title: Murphy's Romance
description: A divorced mother (Sally Field) moves to an Arizona ranch and meets a widowed pharmacist (James Garner) twice her age.

title: About Last Night ...
description: Chicago singles Danny (Rob Lowe) and Debbie (Demi Moore) meet in a bar, move in together and wonder if it's love.

title: Bram Stoker's Dracula
description: The vampire count (Gary Oldman) of Transylvania seeks his lost love (Winona Ryder) and the conquest of Britain by plague.

title: Awakenings
description: A doctor (Robin Williams) tries the drug L-dopa on an immobile man (Robert De Niro) and others like him in 1969 New York.

title: Julie & Julia
description: A woman in Queens, N.Y., sets a deadline of one year to prepare all 524 recipes in Julia Child's famous cookbook, "Mastering the Art of French Cooking."

title: Walk Hard: The Dewey Cox Story
description: Following a childhood tragedy, Dewey Cox (John C. Reilly) rises to music stardom, falls victim to drug abuse, and finds the love of a good woman (Jenna Fischer).

title: Takers
description: A determined detective (Matt Dillon) and Russian mobsters complicate the plan of a gang of skilled thieves to rob an armored car carrying millions of dollars.

title: Legion
description: A battle for the future of mankind unfolds when the archangel Michael (Paul Bettany) arrives at a roadside diner to protect a waitress whose unborn child is humanity's last hope.

title: White Boy Rick
description: In 1980s Detroit, Rick Wershe Jr. agrees to become an undercover drug informant in exchange for keeping his father out of prison. When young Rick gets in too deep, he finds himself seduced by the lure of easy money and becomes a drug dealer himself.

title: Bad Country
description: After arresting a contract killer, a Louisiana detective tries to convince him to become an informant in an attempt to bring down the South's most powerful criminal organization.

title: Against All Odds
description: A Los Angeles bookie (James Woods) hires an ex-football star (Jeff Bridges) to find his runaway mistress (Rachel Ward) in Mexico.

title: Sahara
description: An Army sergeant (James Belushi), his crew (Mark Lee, Paul Empson) and stragglers try to hold off a Nazi battalion at a Libyan waterhole.

title: Bermuda Triangle
description: A physician's (Sam Behrens) family is stranded on an island community of survivors presumed lost in the infamous Bermuda Triangle.

title: The Last Dragonslayer
description: A young orphan girl (Ellise Chappell), indentured servant to a magician, discovers that she's destined to become the last dragonslayer in a world with only one remaining dragon.

title: Facing the Giants
description: A Christian high-school football coach (Alex Kendrick) inspires the players on his losing team through his steadfast belief in God.

title: Wild America
description: Three Arkansas brothers (Jonathan Taylor Thomas, Devon Sawa, Scott Bairstow) travel across the country filming animals in their habitats during the summer of 1967.

title: Places in the Heart
description: A widowed mother fights for her cotton farm with a laborer and a blind boarder in the 1930s Texas.

title: Eat Pray Love
description: Facing a crossroads in her life, a divorcee (Julia Roberts) travels to Italy, India and Bali on a quest to change her life and find true happiness.

title: Bram Stoker's Dracula
description: The vampire count (Gary Oldman) of Transylvania seeks his lost love (Winona Ryder) and the conquest of Britain by plague.

title: Darkness Falls
description: The spirit of a woman who was lynched more than 150 years earlier haunts residents (Emma Caulfield, Lee Cormie) of a New England town.

title: Blue-Eyed Butcher
description: Susan Wright (Sara Paxton) stands trial for the murder of her husband (Justin Bruening) in their Texas home.

title: Little Nikita
description: An FBI agent (Sidney Poitier) finds a dormant link between an Air Force Academy applicant's (River Phoenix) parents and the KGB.

title: Crooked House
description: Someone poisons the patriarch of the wealthy Leonides family, leading to an investigation.

title: Mary Reilly
description: Gentle Dr. Jekyll (John Malkovich) confides in a young chambermaid (Julia Roberts) and transforms into evil Mr. Hyde in 19th-century London.

title: The Lazarus Project
description: A death-row inmate (Paul Walker) searches for the truth after he mysteriously awakes in a psychiatric hospital.

title: Dirty
description: Two corrupt Los Angeles policemen (Cuba Gooding Jr., Clifton Collins Jr.) endure separate investigations from Internal Affairs.

title: Hardwired
description: A man (Cuba Gooding Jr.) turns to hackers for help after he awakes from a car accident and learns he has a computer chip implanted in his brain.

title: Red Water
description: A shark terrorizes a divorced couple (Lou Diamond Phillips, Kristy Swanson) and three boat hijackers on a Louisiana river.

title: The Fog
description: Residents (Tom Welling, Maggie Grace, Selma Blair) of a seaside community fall prey to malevolent entities hidden within the thick mist around their homes.

title: Legion
description: A battle for the future of mankind unfolds when the archangel Michael (Paul Bettany) arrives at a roadside diner to protect a waitress whose unborn child is humanity's last hope.

title: Anaconda
description: A snake hunter (Jon Voight) commandeers a documentary crew (Jennifer Lopez, Ice Cube) in the Brazilian jungle, forcing them to battle a monster boa.

title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
description: A scientific expedition sets out for Borneo to seek a flower called the Blood Orchid, which could grant longer life. Meanwhile, they run afoul of snakes and each other.

title: The Princess and the Marine
description: A Marine has a forbidden romance with a Muslim Bahraini princess and sneaks her to the United States to marry her.

title: Wings of Courage
description: A pilot (Craig Sheffer) crashes during a terrible storm, walks away, and gets lost in the Andes Mountains.

title: Birdy
description: A Vietnam veteran helps his bird-obsessed boyhood buddy in a psychiatric hospital.

title: The Marine 6: Close Quarters
description: Jake Carter and another former Marine, Luke Trapper, join forces to rescue a kidnapped girl from a gang of international criminals.
